Class TestRunner

java.lang.Object
myTest.TestRunner
public class TestRunner extends Object
TestRunner class for executing the complete test suite for the adapter implementation.

The test suite includes the following test classes:

  • EnumerationAdapterTest
  • IteratorAdapterTest
  • ListIteratorAdapterTest
  • StackAdapterTest
  • SubListAdapterTest
  • VectorAdapterTest

This runner provides comprehensive output including:

  • Execution header with environment information
  • Detailed test statistics (pass/fail/ignore counts)
  • Failure details with relevant stack traces
  • Performance metrics (execution time, memory usage)
  • Summary of test execution results

The runner exits with status code 1 if any tests fail, 0 if all tests pass.

Testing Framework Information

This test suite utilizes JUnit 4.13 testing framework with Hamcrest 1.3 matchers for assertions. These dependencies are located as follows:

  • JUnit 4.13: lib/junit-4.13.jar
  • Hamcrest Core 1.3: Matcher/hamcrest-core-1.3.jar
